The '''Gnarls Outpost''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] base located in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Flesh Raider uprising]], a group of the native [[Flesh Raider]]s attacked the Gnarls Outpost under the command of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Callef]].
